description: Estimated LLM spend in the evaluation window exceeded the target. Cost is DERIVED by formula (tokens x price) at the real Fireworks kimi-k2p7-code rates ($0.95 / 1M input = 0.00000095, $4.00 / 1M output = 0.000004). This is a trace-side estimate (no cache-read discount, so it overstates on cache-heavy windows); the metric-based twin alert (llm-cost-spike-metric) fires on the precise gen_ai.client.operation.cost counter — prefer that one for exact-dollar paging.
